<!-- ===================== ABOUT ME ===================== -->
## &nbsp;🧭&nbsp; About Me

<img align="right" width="280" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Mechanical CAD/CAE motif">

I'm a **Mechanical Engineer and Independent Researcher** based in India, working at the intersection of **engineering design, simulation, and computational analysis**. My focus is on turning hands-on hardware prototypes — electric vehicle systems, embedded control architectures, and CFD studies — into rigorously documented, peer-reviewed research.

- 🔬 Currently developing **research manuscripts on electric two-wheeler retrofit systems**, spanning propulsion authorization control and reusable systems-engineering methodology
- 🌀 Background in **CFD & FEA analysis** using ANSYS Workbench, with ongoing airfoil aerodynamics studies
- 🛠️ Full engineering pipeline experience: **CAD design → fabrication → simulation → technical documentation → publication**
- 🤖 Building **AI/ML-assisted engineering tools**, including a CFD result analysis application
- 🎓 Actively pursuing **Project Assistant / Research Associate / JRF** roles at research institutes, with a longer-term goal of a **Master's degree abroad**

### ⚡ RAIDER SAI — Electric Bike Platform
Design, fabrication, and engineering analysis of a custom **48V/1000W BLDC** electric two-wheeler with a **4-speed mechanical transmission**, led as team leader. Serves as the core research platform behind multiple journal manuscripts on retrofit EV systems and propulsion control.

**Focus areas:** EV Powertrain Design · BLDC Motor · Battery Systems · Mechanical Transmission · Fabrication

### 📡 App-Controlled Ignition System
An **ESP32-based** context-aware ignition/pre-ignition authorization system for an electric bike retrofit, featuring Bluetooth communication with a mobile application, battery voltage monitoring, Hall-effect wheel-speed sensing, and a safety-interlock control architecture.

**Focus areas:** Embedded Systems · BLE Communication · Sensor Integration · Safety-Critical Control Logic

`ESP32` `Embedded Systems` `Mobile Integration`

<td width="50%" valign="top">

### 🌊 NACA 0012 Airfoil — CFD Analysis
Steady-state incompressible aerodynamic CFD study of the NACA 0012 airfoil in **ANSYS Workbench** using the k-ω SST turbulence model, evaluated at 0° and 5° angles of attack, with ongoing validation against classical experimental aerodynamics data.

**Focus areas:** ANSYS Fluent · Turbulence Modeling · Aerodynamic Analysis · Result Validation

`CFD` `ANSYS Workbench` `Aerodynamics`

</td>

An AI/ML-assisted software application for structured post-processing and interpretation of CFD simulation results — built as a portfolio project applying software architecture principles (modular design, scalability, documentation standards) to engineering data analysis.

**Focus areas:** Python · Data Analysis · Software Architecture · AI/ML for Engineering
